notes.title: Impossible Jumpy Quest - Newest Version released!
notes.notes:
What's new?

+25 New Challenging Extra Levels

+ A Way to select Levels directly

+Some Look Changes

+Introducing the first Challenge-Mode to the game

+More little things

We will also readjust the pricing for the time being in Early-Acces,
from 9.99 to 1.99 to give players a really good oportunity, incentivising
to play our fun game. ;)

On this note we want to thank the brave people that have played the game
already, and payed the previous full price. Every little counts to keep indie-projects like this going. Thank you very much!

Have fun with the new Version! 

Let us know in the community hub.
